key.name: poll-interval
key.description: Floor is 180s. Claude Code itself caches for 5 minutes, and polling faster than that gains nothing while risking rate-limit throttling.

key.name: hidden-quotas
key.summary: Quota ids explicitly hidden from the panel

key.name: auto-hide-inactive
key.summary: Hide quotas that are inactive, zero and have no reset scheduled

key.name: show-window-labels
key.summary: Show a short window tag (5h, wk) next to each gauge

key.name: show-pool-totals
key.summary: Show combined pool totals as their own gauges
key.description: Some providers report both a shared pool and its per-product breakdown — Grok's Build and Chat gauges already sum to its Credits pool. Off by default to avoid a redundant gauge; the pool is always in the menu.

key.name: warn-threshold
key.summary: Percentage at which a quota turns amber

key.name: critical-threshold
key.summary: Percentage at which a quota turns red

key.name: notifications-enabled
key.summary: Send a desktop notification when a quota crosses a threshold

key.name: color-normal
key.summary: Gauge fill colour below the warning threshold

key.name: color-warn
key.summary: Gauge fill colour at or above the warning threshold

key.name: color-critical
key.summary: Gauge fill colour at or above the critical threshold
